notes.title: MIX SIGN IS BACK IN REMASTER VERSION!
notes.notes:
MIX SIGN IS BACK!
Re-explore the Mix Sign adventure with Luna and Adriel in HD: A Girl with 3 signs.
The original game made in RPG Maker, now being remade in Godot Engine for PC and Mobile.

More news in the future!
Believe in signs again… SOON!

Made by Instal Entretenimento with Kellenkyo.

notes.notes:

notes.title: This month Mix-Sign: Girl with 3 Signs completes a year!
notes.notes:
This month Mix-Sign: Girl with 3 Signs completes a year!
The game started the project through the idea to create a comic that was stopped for a long time in 2015, in March 2019 the creator decided to use the stopped comic project and transformed a game. The duration of the game process lasted 10 months, these times ended up finishing the doation with 110% and was published on steam. And it was released on the 6th of January.
 
So ... Thank you very much who supported me and played the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36431572/c7d2fd58455c963b5197fcde27e2893c8790b1ef.png[/img]



[b]
P.S: The story will continue !!![/b]

notes.title: Mix-Sign: Girl with 3 Signs in Spanish!
notes.notes:
[h3][b]I came to give you very good news![/b][/h3]
The game in Spanish is ready and you can play in Spanish.

[u][h3][b]If you have a game in your library, but don't know how to change?[/b][/h3][/u]
I'll help you, just go to your library, go to your games list and look for the Mix-sign there, then right-click and there will appear the steam configuration. And at the end there is a language tab and you select "Spanish".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36431572/91044a3dbc2aa9fee33327b14c73f6e8f9208f10.png[/img]


[b]P.S.: [/b]If text is wrong or bug, you can send a message about it. ( =>w0)/"')

notes.title: Spanish text is ready, now I have to pass the texts within the game!
notes.notes:
Hello people!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36431572/1c9e47218a94829d82e70c2e3667cb1dd0b1ba1f.png[/img]
It is a great news about the translation of the Mix-sign that was ready in Spanish, now I have started hands-on to get the game out in Spanish.

I'm sure it will be ready at the end of this month, otherwise ... next month!

The people translated the game, thank you so much for helping me!

notes.title: The text of game is being translated into English.
notes.notes:
Hello.
I came to say that some people are translating the Mix-sign texts in English, but it may take a long time to release the game in English and it may be released this month (January) or February.

In the meantime, well ... I am updating the game to remove the bugs and putting the wallpaper arts (for mobile and PC) into the game until it is 100% complete.
